description: She wears a muted purple floor-length gown with a low square neckline and elbow-length sleeves, edged by narrow gold geometric woven borders. Round shoulder clasps, a narrow decorated belt with a circular buckle and a light underdress add detail. An ivory wrap with purple-and-gold edging hangs loosely around her forearms. Brown-gold flat shoes are visible beneath the hem; her head is bare.
